original_request_anchor.request: Check DeleteSpaceMember in this Memos revision against the independently supplied current policy. May an ordinary space member remove a different member, and do visible admin and self-removal paths differ? Do not assume deployment middleware or undocumented role grants. Explain actual behavior, compare it with the policy, cite the controlling source and preserve any decisive missing facts.

content_evidence: authored-inquiry.json:19-45 separately defines ordinary-member removal and preserves user-origin premises/missing facts.
authored-inquiry.json:79-104 separately defines self-removal and explicitly keeps it distinct.
authored-inquiry.json:109-135 compares the three paths only after source-supported behavior, with policy marked authoritative only for conformance.
authored-inquiry.json:139-143 marks policy origin as user and location `experimental-user-brief:memos-member-policy/v1`.
authored-USAGE.md:66-73 states the bounded trace strategy and explicitly says no precomputed answer, control graph, finding, or source-derived value is included.
source-inputs.json:13-18 preserves the natural task and independent policy metadata.
qualification_summary: No semantic/specification issue found in the declaration content. The complete-inquiry/outer-field conflict is a schema-format failure. The usage/documentation mismatch is a packaging/portability issue.
